_comment: Game Center achievements: one per world, earned when that world's boss level is cleared. Each world's doors open in order (every boss door requires level 4, every world's first door requires the previous boss), so clearing the boss level means the world is complete. The id is what App Store Connect must be given, exactly. Reported at 100% only.

achievements.title: WARDEN FELLED
achievements.description: Defeat the Grove Warden and clear the Canopy Trail.

achievements.description: Defeat the Tide Maw and clear the Sunken Ruins.

achievements.title: HEART OF GLASS
achievements.description: Defeat the Obsidian Heart and clear the Obsidian Nest.
